candidate_order: First three distinct direct official PDF/document URLs in displayed result order; citation IDs are not ranks. Full raw response and all metadata preserved and independently reconciled before registration. No HTML-link expansion, rerun, alternate query, or replacement search. A known prior URL still consumes its bounded slot and is excluded without reacquisition.
search_year: 2026 is a literal search term, not a publication-date eligibility requirement. Fresh means unseen in rounds 1–7, including development and excluded candidates.
state_spread: At most one retained notice per state until six distinct states have been retained, then at most two. This frozen chronological rule applies before search; no performance-based substitution.
stop: Stop immediately at eight retained notices, exactly six general and two conditional/hearing controls, at least six states and <=40 pages. Otherwise resolve Q24 bounded candidates and stop with honest shortfall.
planning_basis: Prior platform experience only: broader official agency domains rather than whole-register-only endpoints; no fresh source content, platform query or download used to form this rotation. Domain availability and search yields remain unverified.
